answer_requirements.rule: When a user asks for evidence, source, original text, commentary, or notes, the visible draft_answer must include a readable text cue or short quote from at least one card for each requested evidence type; a source title or generic source-layer label alone is not sufficient.

entity_intro.fate_default_opening: 按当前证据范围看，能直接支持的是：
entity_intro.fate_later_forty_opening: 按后四十回范围看，当前证据能直接支持的是：
entity_intro.fate_default_boundary: 这些材料可以说明文本中的命运线索；更完整的终局叙事仍需要继续命中对应情节。
entity_intro.fate_later_forty_boundary: 这些材料必须标注为后四十回内容；它们可以说明该版本中的后续遭际，不能回推为前八十回正文或脂批范围内的确定结论。
excluded_public_quote_terms: 要知端的，且聽下回分解
要知端的，且听下回分解
entity_intro.rule: For entity/person introduction questions, compose from multiple readable in-package evidence cards when available; skip short speech-shell fragments and narrative transition formulae in favor of substantive passages, and state the evidence boundary instead of writing a biography from outside the package.

chapter_location.no_evidence_template: 请再明确要定位的情节口径。当前证据包没有命中能把“{event}”定位到具体回目的可用材料，不能改答成人物介绍。
chapter_location.ambiguous_template: 当前证据包把“{event}”相关线索命中到多个回目：{locations}。请明确你要问的是正面情节发生回目，还是文本中出现/追提该线索的回目。
chapter_location.rule: For chapter-location questions, answer the chapter number first. Prefer chapter heading/title and direct base-text evidence. Commentary may be visible only when the quote itself explains the location or title relation; do not cite isolated local comments that do not explain what they support.

character_fate.default_scope_label: 默认范围（前八十回正文 + 脂批）
character_fate.later_forty_scope_label: 本次明确纳入后四十回范围
character_fate.missing_evidence_template: 就当前证据包看，还没有命中能绑定{entity}结局或命运的判词、曲文、脂批归属证据；不能只凭普通人物提及来概括结局。
character_fate.prophecy_opening_template: 按{scope}看，{entity}的结局不能直接写成完整情节结局；较稳妥的回答是：相关材料把其命运写成带有{cues}等预示性线索。
character_fate.limited_opening_template: 按{scope}看，{entity}的结局还缺少可直接概括的情节证据；当前只能说明命运相关材料中出现了{cues}等线索。
character_fate.attribution_sentence: 脂批可以用于确认相关句子与人物的对应关系。
character_fate.default_scope_boundary: 这些材料属于前八十回正文或脂批范围；没有后续叙事证据时，回答应保持为命运预示或可据此推断，不能说成正文已经发生的完整结局。
character_fate.later_forty_scope_boundary: 这些材料属于用户已放开的后四十回范围；不能回推为默认前八十回正文加脂批范围内的确定结论。
character_fate.rule: For character fate answers, the opening should summarize substantive prophecy cues from bound fate slots, not attribution-only commentary fragments or generic labels; excluded_opening_cue_terms are filtered from the public opening while still allowed in evidence quotes.

evidence_query.matched_intro_template: 有。{evidence_label}中与{subject}这一问题绑定的证据主要是：
evidence_query.no_requested_type_template: 当前证据包没有命中与{subject}这一问题绑定的{evidence_label}证据；不能用未绑定材料替代。
evidence_query.boundary_sentence: 用法上，这些材料只能说明与当前问题绑定的证据线索；未绑定到该主体或该语义槽位的材料不能作为本次回答依据。
evidence_query.rule: For evidence follow-up answers, bind evidence to the resolved subject and semantic slot before applying requested source-layer preference; do not answer a commentary request with unrelated commentary just because it ranks high globally.

slot_count.default_scope_label: 默认范围（前八十回正文 + 脂批）
slot_count.later_forty_scope_label: 本次明确纳入后四十回范围
slot_count.empty_direct_template: 按{scope}看，严格按“{basis_label}”口径，当前证据不能直接支持具体次数。
slot_count.direct_count_template: 按{scope}看，严格按“{basis_label}”口径，当前证据能直接支持{count}{unit}：{labels}。
slot_count.default_boundary_sentence: 后四十回未纳入，除非用户明确要求。
slot_count.later_forty_boundary_sentence: 回答仍按证据来源层标注。
slot_count.related_template: 另有{count}条流转/疑似线索，不能直接计入次数：{labels}。
slot_count.rule: For count-style answers, compose public wording from slot semantics and source-scope policy; direct slots may be counted, related or suspicious slots remain visible but are not counted as direct events.

attribute_age.rule: For age attribute questions, extract explicit age cues near the requested entity, allow bounded inference only from in-package age cues, and label event-time or comparison answers as inference unless the package directly fixes the exact age.

rationale_followup.rule: When a user asks a follow-up about reasoning, logic, basis, or why an earlier answer was inferred, answer by explaining the evidence chain and uncertainty boundary instead of restating the original conclusion.
